note: "rest" is real English one edit from the graph verb "test", and both operands resolve — so a repair would earn a confident "No — no tests edge found" to a question nobody asked. A real word is not a typo, so the repair tier never fires and the sentence misses honestly instead.

the twin of the real-word row above, and the reason the gate is a collision table rather than a blanket refusal: "impotr" is not an English word, so it is a typo, the repair tier fires, and the question answers off the imports edges.

the inflected form is the case a plain lemma list misses: "rests" appears in no dictionary that carries only lemmas, yet it is a real word one edit from "tests". The collision table is generated with the -s/-ed/-ing forms so it lands on the miss wall like its lemma.
